content: Sorry, you have the wrong number. I am Arnav.
I am sorry, but I am calling regarding an overdue EMI for a Samsung Smart TV. Are you the Arnav who purchased this product from EasyCredit?
I have noted the dispute. I will make sure this is looked into.
No, I never bought this TV, this loan is not mine. Please raise a dispute and stop these calls.
Good, please stop calling me now.
